snippet.title: Ultimate Sheep Raccoon – Announcement Trailer – Nintendo Switch & Nintendo Switch 2
snippet.description:
Ultimate Sheep Raccoon is coming to Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2 this winter 2025!

Ultimate Sheep Raccoon is a bike-racing party game where you and your friends build the course together. Add obstacles and dangerous traps, take the lead with power-ups, and race to the finish.

#UltimateSheepRaccoon #NintendoSwitch #NintendoSwitch2 #IndieWorld
